title: Marlowe & Finch Gift Registry Ledger Standard: Completion Discount on an Order Line
content:
**Standard.** The completion discount of the Marlowe & Finch Gift Registry on an order line — the registrant's purchase record of a registry item still in ordered status — is the registry type's completion discount percent taken on the line's selling price. The completion discounts recorded on a registry together never exceed the registry type's completion discount cap, and a line that would pass the cap receives only the part of the cap still unused. The completion discount covers the line only while the item still has at least one requested unit left; when no unit is left the completion discount is nil. The completion discount is rounded half up to the cent once, on the final amount.

## Quantities and where they are read

| Quantity | Definition | Record |
|---|---|---|
| Selling price | the unit price of the order line | the registrant's purchase record in ordered status |
| Completion percent | the registry type's completion discount percent | the registry type's completion discount schedule |
| Requested units left | the requested quantity of the item's most recent item entry, less the number of guest gift entries for that item, less the number of completion purchase entries for that item | the registry's entries for the line's item number |
| Unused cap | the registry type's completion discount cap less the total of the completion discounts recorded on the registry's completion purchase entries, never below zero | the registry type's schedule and the registry's entries |

## Assembly

The amount found is the completion percent of the selling price. The amount found is kept only when the item still has a requested unit left, and the unused part of the cap is applied to it before the rounding, which is done once, half up to the cent, on the final amount. The completion discount is therefore the lesser of the amount found (nil when no unit is left) and the unused cap, rounded once.

## Worked figures (hypothetical registry type: completion discount percent 12, cap USD 300.00)

| Line | Selling price | Units left | Discounts already recorded | Amount found | Unused cap | Completion discount |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| A | USD 170.00 | 2 | USD 110.00 | USD 20.40 | USD 190.00 | USD 20.40 |
| B | USD 170.00 | 2 | USD 290.00 | USD 20.40 | USD 10.00 | USD 10.00 |
| C | USD 170.00 | 0 | USD 110.00 | — | USD 190.00 | nil |
| D | USD 64.99 | 1 | USD 0.00 | USD 7.7988 | USD 300.00 | USD 7.80 |

Line D shows the single rounding: the amount is carried unrounded through the cap comparison and rounded half up to the cent only at the end.
